Cc: procurement@nimbus-sys.com, Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@nimbus-sys.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft order form / net terms question

Hi Grace,

Thanks for sending the draft order form. A few items procurement and finance asked us to confirm before we can route for PO: 

- Net terms: we typically require Net 60 for platform vendors. Is there flexibility to move from Net 30 to Net 60 once we have an approved PO?
- Invoice cadence: we prefer a single consolidated monthly invoice to our AP system rather than multiple per-commit invoices. Can Redwood provide consolidated invoicing?
- Tax evidence: our tax team needs your EU VAT certificate and confirmation of Redwood's tax residency for invoicing. Could you attach any VAT registration documents and a suggested invoice flow?

We're under a time constraint to finalize before our fiscal close on 11/15. Appreciate a quick alignment so we can generate a PO.

Best,
Elliot
Procurement Manager
Nimbus Systems

Date: 2028-11-07T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft order form / net terms question

Elliot —

Thanks for the callout and the timeline. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Net terms: Our standard is Net 30. For committed contracts we can offer Net 45 by exception; Net 60 is a stretch but we can escalate to Finance for approval if the customer increases the minimum commit by ~15% (we'd need to quantify the uplift).
- Consolidated invoicing: Yes — we can consolidate into one monthly invoice. That is a standard option on the order form; I'll flag the invoice routing section for legal/ops to confirm formatting for your AP system.
- Tax evidence: attaching the VAT registration/exportable certificate and a short tax-residency note. Kimberly in finance/legal is looped to provide formal wording; she may attach a redline to the order form.

Proposed next step: Kimberly will provide a proposed language change to the payment terms and an invoice-flow appendix. If you can confirm the PO holder entity and any remit-to-ids, we'll prepare a DocuSign-ready order form and send to your procurement team by end of day tomorrow.

Talk soon,
Grace
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Order form payment terms / proposed redlines

Team —

I reviewed the order form and drafted a short appendix and a single redline to the Payment Terms section to cover: consolidated monthly invoice, net terms exception, and VAT handling. Key points: 

1) Net terms exception language (for approval flow): "Notwithstanding Section X, Customer may request Net 45 or Net 60 payment terms subject to Redwood's Finance approval and a commensurate adjustment to minimum committed spend; Redwood will not unreasonably withhold approval for Net 45 requests for customers with established credit and a signed PO."

2) Consolidated invoicing: add Appendix A specifying invoice ID fields required by Nimbus AP (Company name, PO number, remit-to, tax id, currency).

3) VAT evidence: attach standard VAT certificate and add line requiring Customer to provide any local tax registration numbers; Redwood will supply a VAT invoice compliant with EU rules and will not gross up tax unless law requires.

I've attached a PDF redline (Nimbus_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf) — it's been edited to keep language narrow to avoid reopening MSA. Laura, any concerns about the proposed Net 60 escalation clause? Ben, does the minimum-commit uplift threshold look acceptable (~15%) for this deal size (DEAL-98234)?

-K

Kimberly —

15% uplift to get Net 60 is reasonable for this account given expected volume growth and likelihood to expand in 2029. If we can preserve the consolidated invoice and keep the approval path narrow (Finance only), i'm comfortable. Recommend calling the clause out as "Finance approval for extended terms — approval will be provided within 5 business days."

Grace — happy to sign off once we confirm PO entity and the signed redline is attached.

-Ben

Subject: Re: Order Form — staggered commit billing path, net terms & tax evidence

Elliot —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is the redlined order form with a short appendix for invoice routing and the VAT certificate. Summary of what we can do for Nimbus: 

- Consolidated monthly invoicing: confirmed. Appendix A lists the invoice fields we will populate.
- Net terms: Standard Net 30. For Net 45 we can approve without changes. Net 60 is possible with Finance approval + 15% uplift to the minimum commit; Finance commits to respond within 5 business days of receiving PO + completed credit info.
- VAT / tax evidence: attached certificate and a one-paragraph residency statement. Redwood will issue VAT-compliant invoices for EU entities; any local withholding will be handled per local law.

If that aligns, please confirm the PO entity (name, remit-to address, and PO number format) and I'll send DocuSign for signature tomorrow morning so your AP team can route for PO before 11/15.

Cheers,
Grace
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
